reply.text:
Shoulders respond to a mix of heavy pressing and direct side delt work. Overhead press or a dumbbell shoulder press, 3 to 4 sets in the 6 to 10 rep range, is your main driver. Add lateral raises for 3 sets of 12 to 20, because the side delts are what give you width and they respond well to higher reps and frequent work.

Don't skip the rear delts: face pulls or reverse flyes keep the shoulder balanced and add thickness from behind. Hitting shoulders 2 to 3 times a week with moderate volume usually beats one big session, as long as you add a rep or a little weight over time and stop sets a rep or two short of failure.

If you want, I can build you a program with a shoulder focus, or a shoulder day for today. Just say the word.
